comparison.objective: Present a calibration checkerboard in the views needed for camera calibration, then return it to its rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual board handling with precise pose coverage, visibility control, and steady holds.
comparison.success_condition: All positional, scale, and skew views detected; focal length recovered within tolerance; board returned, released, and still.
comparison.reason: Tests multi-view visual target presentation and calibration observability, with no threaded setting or locking operation.
